# do_BoxPlot() | Box-and-whisker plots

```{r}
#| results: "asis"
#| echo: false
source("../_common.R")
```

Box plots provide a statistical summary of distributions across groups.

## Basic usage

```{r}
#| eval: false
p <- SCpubr::do_BoxPlot(sample = sample,
                        features = "CD3D")
p
```
